observations: The page number «34» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01 and L25: the headings of chapters 1 and 2, in bold, centred, each followed by the reference to the text, centred.

L10-L16: the twelve months, set in two columns of six, each name in italics followed by «=» and the number of days; below the first row the word «Tage» is repeated by ditto marks, „; L15 ends with «(in Schalt-», continued below it at the right, «jahren 30)» (L16). Each printed row is one line here, the cells separated by our «|».

L03: «354 11/30», the 11 raised, the 30 small on the line; L30: «365 1/4», set with a small space before the fraction. Checked: the twelve months of 30 and 29 days alternately make 354 days; with the eleven leap years of L06-L07 the cycle of thirty years has 30 × 354 + 11 = 10631 days, which is thirty years of 354 11/30 days.

L37-L38: the weekday numbers («Notulae», «Signa») of Table 3a. Checked: December has 31 days, four weeks and three days, so that the weekday of 1 January is three after that of 1 December; with the leap day at the end of December, 32 days, it is four after it. L39: the Spanish era, beginning in the year 38 before the Christian era.

Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Kh.», «Alexanders des Grossen», «Nallino», «Maslamas», «Batt.»; italics: the Arabic words and names, «Seleucidischen», «julianischen», «Intercalation» (L35; upright in L40), «Notulae», «Signa», and the letters «dj», «i», «sh», «sc» in L18-L19.
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (9-14 px measured).
